images.title: Three quarters of two fifths
images.purpose: Show 3/4 × 2/5 = 6/20 using a unit square of 5 rows and 4 columns.
images.composition: One large unit square centred, caption below, white space around.
exact_structure: One unit square with 5 equal rows and 4 equal columns: 20 equal cells.
The top 2 rows (8 cells) are filled light teal #0072B2: this is 2/5.
Within those 2 rows, the left 3 columns (6 cells) are filled reddish purple #CC79A7: this is 3/4 of 2/5.
The right column's 2 cells in the teal rows stay light teal; the bottom 3 rows are white.
rejection: purple cells outside the top 2 rows
images.takeaway: 3/4 of 2/5 is 6 of the 20 parts, which is 6/20 = 3/10.
images.description: A grid of 5 rows and 4 columns with 6 purple cells in the top two rows.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Count 20 cells in all and 6 purple cells.

image_decisions.why: The grid makes the multiplication of both fractions visible.
